arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'charge_state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step,'hold',h.booking_id) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON h.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT 'charge' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) AS data FROM bookings b JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'payment_log',json_object('id',id,'status',status,'message',message,'trace_id',trace_id) FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' AND (id<50 OR status>=400) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'status',b.status,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_state',c.state,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'hold',h.booking_id,'checkin',k.booking_id,'refund_amount',r.amount_cents) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON h.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN checkins k ON k.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.charge_id=c.charge_id WHERE c.created_step=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'undelivered_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'status',status,'payload',payload) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'capacity',json_object('flight_id',f.flight_id,'capacity',f.capacity,'holds',count(h.booking_id)) FROM flights f LEFT JOIN holds h ON h.flight_id=f.flight_id GROUP BY f.flight_id

SELECT b.booking_id,b.status,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.amount_cents,c.created_step FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IN ('bkg_68f24f88e3cb5334b374a3cf6c50a021','bkg_a2f5ac0fd7605a43808351d1b1387fa5','bkg_9fed5b08032e56de8cac3693b40db12d') ORDER BY b.booking_id,c.created_step

SELECT 'incomplete_confirmed' AS check_name, count(*) AS violations FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')!=1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id AND k.flight_id=b.flight_id AND k.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'wrong_captured_amount',count(*) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents!=b.amount_cents UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_still_backed',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_without_customer_event',count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id AND e.kind='cancel') UNION ALL SELECT 'refund_wrong_or_unwarranted',count(*) FROM refunds r JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id JOIN charges c ON c.charge_id=r.charge_id WHERE b.status!='cancelled' OR r.amount_cents!=c.amount_cents UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_bookings',count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'undelivered_events',count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold_flights',count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity
